seo.title: Water, fire & mold restoration and remodeling
seo.description: Restoration and remodeling in Vancouver WA and Portland OR. Tell us what happened in a sentence, send a photo, or call — a person answers 24/7.

hero.ask: What do you need help with?

rebuild.title: Ready to rebuild
rebuild.text: Drying is finished. Repairs are next.

happened.title: Let’s get someone on it.
happened.text: Call now, or leave your number and a person from Ona calls you back.

rebuild.title: Let’s plan the repairs.
rebuild.text: Leave your number and ZIP. If you have the estimate or photos, you can send them after.

remodel.title: Tell us what you’re thinking.
remodel.text: Pick the room, leave your number, and we’ll call to talk it through.

existing.title: Your project page.
existing.text: Open it with the link we sent you. Lost the link? Leave the phone number on the project and we’ll send it again.

panel.notePlaceholder: Washing machine leaked upstairs, ceiling below is wet.

panel.needPhone: We need a phone number to call you.
panel.outArea: We’ll check that ZIP when we call.

done.title: Your request is received.
done.text: A person from Ona will call you at the number below to confirm. Nothing is scheduled until we’ve talked.
done.linkText: We’ll send the project link to the number below.
done.photosText: Send them by email with your phone number in the subject — we’ll match them to your request.
done.urgent: If it gets worse, don’t wait — call {phone}.
done.failText: Your email app will open with everything filled in — or just call {phone}.

items.q: What does the first visit cost?
items.a: We go over it on the phone before anything is scheduled. With an insurance claim, you pay your deductible, nothing more.

items.q: Do you work with my insurance?
items.a: We document everything — photos, moisture readings, scope — and share it with you and your adjuster. Your carrier decides coverage. You pay your deductible, nothing more.
Vancouver WA, Portland OR and the towns around them — Camas, Battle Ground, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Gresham, Tigard, Lake Oswego and more.

items.q: Someone else did the drying. Can you do the rebuild?
items.a: Yes. Tell us what you have — the estimate, letters, photos — and we’ll walk the job with you.
Yes. A person answers 24/7 at {phone}. The call-back request is here for when calling isn’t convenient.
